name: fl_dag_task_graph
description: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) task graph and frontier scheduler for multi-step engineering initiatives. Validates task graphs against cycles, calculates topological execution order, identifies the active unblocked frontier for parallel agent execution, and renders Mermaid dependency diagrams.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

action.description: Action to perform: 'evaluate_frontier' (default, finds unblocked tasks ready for execution), 'topological_sort', 'generate_mermaid', or 'validate_dag'.

tasks_json.description: JSON array of task objects, each containing: id, title, blocked_by (array of task ids), status ('pending' or 'done').

tasks_file.description: Path to a JSON or Markdown file containing task definitions.

resolved_task_ids.description: Comma-separated list of completed task IDs to unblock downstream dependencies.

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.
